message.content:
Based on my search, here's how to log in to your **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**:

## Official Login Page

Go to the official Government of Canada portal:
**https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html**

## Sign-In Options

You have **three ways** to sign in:

| Method | What You Need |
|--------|---------------|
| **GCKey** | A Government of Canada username and password (free to create) |
| **Sign-In Partner** | Your existing online banking credentials from participating banks (RBC, TD, Scotiabank, BMO, CIBC, National Bank, Desjardins, etc.) |
| **Provincial Digital ID** | Available if you're in Alberta or British Columbia |

## Step-by-Step Login Process

1. Visit the official MSCA login page (link above)
2. Click **"Sign In"**
3. Select your preferred sign-in method (GCKey, Sign-In Partner, or Provincial ID)
4. Enter your credentials
5. Complete any identity verification steps if prompted
6. Access your dashboard

## What You Can Access in MSCA

- Employment Insurance (EI) claims and reports
- Canada Pension Plan (CPP) contributions and benefits
- Old Age Security (OAS) and Guaranteed Income Supplement (GIS)
- Social Insurance Number (SIN) information
- Tax slips (T4E, T4A)
- Direct deposit information
- Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)
- National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC) account

## Important Notes

- **My Service Canada Account is different from CRA My Account** — they use separate login systems
- If you don't have an account yet, you'll need to register first and may need a **Personal Access Code (PAC)** mailed to you (takes 5-10 business days)
- Supported browsers: Chrome 84+, Safari 13.1.2+, Edge 85+, Firefox 68+
- Clear your browser cache or use private/incognito mode if you experience login issues

## Need Help?

- **Service Canada**: 1-800-O-Canada (1-800-622-6232)
- **Interac support** (for Sign-In Partner issues): 1-855-433-5397

4. https://welcomeaide.com/en/blog/how-to-use-service-canada-online
